limitations_and_boundaries: The study is limited to the Tau-P301S mouse model; human relevance requires further validation.
C1q antibody treatment was acute (5 days); long-term effects and functional outcomes (e.g., LTP) were not improved.
Proteomic changes were assessed at a single time point (9 months); earlier or later stages may differ.
The causal link between GTPase regulator loss and spine loss is based on in vitro knockdown and pharmacological rescue; in vivo genetic validation is lacking.
Microglial engulfment was inferred from lysosomal content; direct visualization of synapse elimination was not performed.
The study does not address whether C1q tagging is specific to phospho-Tau-containing synapses or a general response.
